scope: Complete clean Monte Carlo rerun; preserves every original result/checkpoint. This is reproducibility, not evidence that diagnostic flags or model limitations disappear.

execution.working_directory: Fresh isolated root containing only the two pinned source inputs before execution.

raw_command_execution_record.scope: Actual interpreter argv, absolute local working directory and terminal exit, retained privately in ignored tmp.

ignored_field_rules: Only the listed exact field positions are removed. Checkpoint byte hashes may differ only after all decoded scientific arrays and all other metadata compare exactly; each declared byte hash is checked against its corresponding actual file. All other values, types, numeric bits, shapes, RNG state and resource counts must match.
array_equality: Exact dtype, shape and C-order raw bytes, including signed zeros and NaN payload bytes; no numerical tolerance or equal-NaN relaxation.
scientific_digest_recipe: For each NPZ, sort array keys excluding metadata. For each array append uint64 big-endian header length, canonical JSON {key,dtype:array.dtype.str,shape:list(array.shape)} using sort_keys=True,separators=(comma,colon), then uint64 big-endian payload length and C-order bytes; SHA256 the concatenation. Canonicalize decoded metadata after removing only created_utc and hash it. Per case hash canonical JSON sorted-path records {path,array_payload_sha256,metadata_without_created_utc_sha256}.

complete_local_audit_ledger.content: All2880 paired checkpoint hashes and scientific payload digests; every changed ignored field with original/reproduced values; every scientific mismatch, if any. No raw per-founder arrays published.

preservation: Original simulator, frozen protocol, result aggregates, comparator and original checkpoints were read only; writes are isolated rerun outputs plus this reproduction report.
diagnostic_flags: Existing comparison flags remain findings of the unchanged original scientific aggregates. Exact rerun does not establish Gaussian MCSE adequacy or biological validity.

portable_digest_documentation_check.inputs: Only the clean rerun checkpoints and manifest; no original checkpoint arrays required.
